note: Part lines's entries (docs/GAME.md 2.4, 3.5 step 4; docs/game-parts/lines.md, Interfaces). Beyond src/native/game/README.md's schema (secfind's forms, request 6 of docs/game-parts/secfind.md: "as" a line or a mobj; an output's "native" "zp:NAME"), tools/native/gparts/lines.py reads three more: an output "c" (the native carry, the driver's dg_rp bit 0, against upstream's P bit 0 at the return), "when": "c" (an output compared only when upstream's carry is set: findSpecial's argument and index mean nothing without it) and "div" (upstream's value divided: spectab's offset in 8-byte entries against the native index). lnExit is LSTAB's entry, reached through P_UseSpecialLine and called alone in the synthetic cases: upstream's lnExit takes the line of its switch from SW_LINE (swLine, p_switch65.s:547) and its thing from SW_THING (isPlayer), as P_UseSpecialLine leaves them; the native handler takes them from GA_0-1 and GA_4-5.
